study: Codex platform workflow acceptance trials — environment recovery

invalidAttempt.reason: Every arm was blocked before fixture inspection because the first container could not create the user namespace required by Codex's bwrap sandbox.
invalidAttempt.promptExposure: All four task prompts were exposed to the same model/account during the invalid environment attempt. Recovery results are product acceptance evidence, not unseen-task or benchmark evidence.

authentication.credentialReuse: Reuse the persistent auth volume created by the user's official device flow; never copy or inspect token material.

execution.networkUse: Codex service only; task fixtures and simulated connectors are local

environmentRequirements.userNamespaces: required; preflight must run the bundled bwrap successfully
environmentRequirements.privilege: Docker privileged mode solely to permit nested Codex sandbox namespaces
environmentRequirements.hardTimeout: Each arm runs in its own process group; parent sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL at the frozen cap.

claimLimits: The recovery tasks are not unseen: their prompts were exposed during the invalid environment attempt.
The first dispatch is preserved as an infrastructure incident and contributes zero valid samples.
Privileged mode enables Codex's nested bwrap sandbox; the host source repository remains mounted read-only and only a fresh result volume is writable.
